{{External|rs=Chest (The Barrows Brothers)}} {{Infobox Scenery |version1 = Closed |version2 = Opened |name = Chest |image1 = [[File:Chest (Barrows).png|280px]] |image2 = [[File:Chest (Barrows, open).png|280px]] |release = [[9 May]] [[2005]] |update = Barrows |members = Yes |quest = No |location = [[Barrows]] crypt |options1 = Open |options2 = Search, Close |examine = A large stone chest. |map = {{Map|name=Chest (Barrows)|x=3552|y=9695|mapID=10021|r=3|mtype=square}} |id1 = 20723 |id2 = 20724 |leagueRegion = Morytania }} This '''chest''' is located at the centre of the tunnels beneath the crypts of the [[Barrows brothers]]. It serves as the rewards chest for the [[Barrows]] activity. {{ToC|limit=2}} {{clear|left}} ==Looting the chest== {{Listen |title = [[Grave Robber (Barrows)|Grave Robber]] |align = right |filename = Grave Robber (Barrows).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays upon opening the chest.}} Upon opening the chest, the Barrows brother whose crypt the player entered will appear and start attacking the player, if he did not already appear while travelling through the tunnels. It is not required to kill the Barrows brother in order to loot the chest. However, the chance of getting Barrows equipment from the chest increases as more brothers are killed, and players will not be able to receive equipment belonging to brothers they did not kill. Furthermore, it is '''required''' that you kill at least one enemy of any kind in order to be eligible for any possible loot from the chest. If the player's inventory is full upon looting the chest, excess items will be dropped to the ground. During the [[His Faithful Servants]] miniquest, players will also receive a [[strange icon]]. If the player's inventory is full, or gets filled by other items received as reward, when they would be due to receive an icon, the icon will not be received and the player will need to complete another run. ==Rewards== {{DropLogProject|kills=128000|type=openings}} ''Note that the loot chances below are accurate for a Barrows run with all 6 brothers slain and with full potential (1012 points). To accurately calculate your specific situation, please make use of the [[Calculator:Barrows|Barrows calculator]].'' ===Pre-roll=== The chance to receive one or more items is about ''1/15'' per chest. killed ! colspan="2" |Chance |- !Frac !% |- |1 |1/392 |0.255% |- |2 |1/334 |0.299% |- |3 |1/276 |0.362% |- |4 |1/218 |0.458% |- |5 |1/160 |0.625% |- |6 |1/102 |0.980% |} ===Number of rolls=== *There is initially one roll at the drop table. *Each additional brother killed grants an additional roll at the drop table, to a maximum of seven total rolls. ===Chance of uniques=== *Each brother killed has his associated items added to the possible rewards. *First, the [[Barrows equipment]] is rolled against. The chance of getting a Barrows item is shown in fig.1. Or, in tabular format to the right. *If the Barrows item chance is successfully hit, one of the available Barrows items is chosen at random - each part has equal chance, but once chosen it will not be chosen again on future rolls. \begin{align} P(N) &= \frac{1}{450 - 58 \times N} && (fig. 1) \end{align} Where P is the drop chance and N is the number of [[Barrows brothers|brothers]] killed. ===Chance of other items=== *If the Barrows item chance is not met, an additional measure called ''reward potential'' is calculated as shown below. **In short, reward potential is the sum of all the [[combat level]]s of the monsters killed, capped at 1000 — including the brothers (all six have a combat sum of 656). The number of brothers killed times two is then added, giving a total maximum reward potential of 1012. *A roll is performed for a value between 1 and your reward potential (each inclusive). The result then determines what item is awarded, and in what quantity. Let C_n be the combat level of the nth monster killed. Then, the reward potential R is ::\begin{align} R &= S + 2N \end{align} where ::S \equiv \min \left[ \sum_n C_n , 1000 \right] and ::N \equiv \text{number of brothers killed.} ===Notes=== *The chance of receiving at least one piece of Barrows equipment is approximately 1/15.01{{efn|\frac{7655031554227}{114868566764928} precisely}} if you kill all six brothers. This chance is unaffected by the rewards potential that is built by killing other monsters in the crypt. The chance of receiving a specific piece of equipment is approximately 1/350.14.{{efn|\frac{1504645995025870049809}{526841398983178397417472} precisely}} *As it is possible to receive more than one piece of Barrows equipment per chest, the average number of Barrows pieces per chest is 7/102 (~1/14.57). *In order to receive a piece of Barrows equipment, the corresponding brother must be killed before the chest is looted. Thus, if you wanted a piece of [[Guthan's equipment]], you would have to kill Guthan before you are eligible to obtain his equipment. Therefore, it is impossible to acquire Barrows equipment if no brothers are slain, although coins, runes, or bolt racks may still be awarded. *For every brother killed, you get an extra roll for rewards; so if all six brothers are killed, it is possible to obtain up to seven pieces of Barrows equipment. *It is possible to get multiple items from the same brother, but it is not possible to receive multiple copies of the same item. *Killing all of the brothers is '''not''' required to receive loot; however, not killing all brothers decreases your chance of receiving a Barrows item. *When hunting for your last few uniques, killing all 6 of the barrows brothers compared to just one increases your chance to receive a specific piece of loot around x2.24 times. Therefore, if your run times to kill all of the brothers are x2.24 longer than to kill a single brother, you should consider only killing a specific brother to increase loot chances.
